errors.evidence: The description for the blue series' points is very detailed, but the y-values are significantly overestimated. For example, the point annotated 0.5 has a y-value of approximately 0.67 according to the description, but the plot shows it is closer to 0.57. Similarly, the point annotated 0.4 is at y=0.55 in the description, but at y=0.5 in the plot. The point annotated 0.3 is at y=0.39 in the description but y~0.3 in the plot.
The description states the orange series ends at approximately y=0.60, but the plot clearly shows this point is at y=0.5.
The description states an intermediate point for the orange series is at y=0.49, but the plot shows the point with x=0.10 is at y=0.4.
The description states the higher point on the green series is at y=0.64, but the plot shows this point is at y=0.5.
The description states the higher point on the red series is at y=0.63, but the plot shows this point is at y=0.5.
